name: Cross-sectional funding dispersion — fade the most-positive-funding names (short, 4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the short leg of the funding-dispersion thesis. Across the universe each 4h bar, the most-POSITIVE-funding names (crowded longs, carry drag) tend to UNDER-perform — the marginal buyer is a fee-insensitive leveraged latecomer paying rich funding, and the carry bleed thins demand. We short (direction -1) the names whose funding_rate is at the top of the cross-section and RECEIVE the positive funding carry (funding_feature) while the crowded-long premium unwinds, filtering by a minimum open_interest for tradability. This is the sticky-funding dispersion the giants ignore on smaller names. Distinct from variant 16 (opposite tail, short side). DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if the short edge is eaten by real fees + borrow/slippage on thin books (long-tail trap). DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if it is disguised inverse-beta (most-positive-funding = most-pumped alts = mean-revert regardless of funding) and dies after neutralizing to trailing return. DISCONFIRMER 3: kill if in a broad bull leg high funding stays pinned across the whole cross-section for weeks and the short is run over — the edge must be the DISPERSION (relative), not the level.
catalyst: the richest-positive-funding names in the cross-section, filtered for tradable OI — a crowded-long fade short.
